description: VCA with three CV inputs of different kinds

params.text: The knob sets how far the VCA opens; a 0-10V CV here takes over, attenuated by the knob. Patch an envelope
Bipolar, attenuverted, and scaled by whatever LEVEL is doing. Patch an LFO for tremolo
0-10V, scaled by V. R. and inverted, so a low voltage cuts the output. Meant for the velocity output of MIDI-CV
Linear in amplitude instead of decibels

inputs.text: The knob sets how far the VCA opens; a 0-10V CV here takes over, attenuated by the knob. Patch an envelope
Bipolar, attenuverted, and scaled by whatever LEVEL is doing. Patch an LFO for tremolo
0-10V, scaled by V. R. and inverted, so a low voltage cuts the output. Meant for the velocity output of MIDI-CV
The signal into the VCA; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony

outputs.text: The signal after the VCA, soft-clipped at 12V

menu: Level knob/CV scales bipolar CV — the bipolar CV is multiplied by the LEVEL setting before being added to it; turn it off and the two are added without scaling
